Strategy: Grade leftovers in three zones. Tiny leftovers mean a nearly exact fill, usable ones stay productive, but the middle zone wastes most: too big to ignore, too small to use. Score by leftover: bonus for usable ones, penalty for middle ones, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a tinier or usable one. Exact fits rank top. It may help by avoiding muddled middles, but may fail by overvaluing tiny leftovers later items never fill.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if r - item >= item else 0) - (item if r - item >= item / 4 and r - item < item else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Three-zone grading: bonus for usable leftovers, penalty for middle dead zone [item/4, item).
